high.description:
Key Responsibilities



- Develop and maintain web applications using React.js , Next.js , Node.js , Express.js , and MongoDB .
- Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services.
- Build responsive, user-friendly, and high-performance frontend applications.
- Develop server-side rendered (SSR) and static site generated (SSG) applications using Next.js.
- Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third-party services.
- Optimize applications for speed, scalability, and security.
- Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following best practices.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues.
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical discussions.
- Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement pixel-perfect designs.
- Work with Git for version control and follow Agile/Scrum methodologies.
- Deploy and maintain applications on cloud platforms.

Requirements



- Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript .
- Hands-on experience with React.js .
- Good experience with Next.js (SSR, SSG, ISR, API Routes).
- Experience with Redux Toolkit , Context API, or Zustand.
- Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, and Responsive Design.
- Familiarity with Material UI or similar component libraries.

Back end



- Strong experience with Node.js and Express.js .
- Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs .
- Knowledge of authentication and authorization using JWT , OAuth , and role-based access control (RBAC).
- Understanding of API security, rate limiting, input validation, and best practices.
- Experience integrating third-party APIs and payment gateways is a plus.

Database



- Strong experience with MongoDB and Mongoose .
- Good knowledge of MySQL , including database design, indexing, joins, stored procedures, and query optimization.
- Ability to design efficient database schemas for both NoSQL and relational databases.
- Experience writing optimized queries and handling database migrations.
- Knowledge of ORMs/ODMs such as Mongoose , Sequelize , or Prisma is an added advantage.

DevOps & Tools



- Proficiency with Git and GitHub/GitLab .
- Basic knowledge of Docker and containerized application deployment.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience deploying applications on Azure , AWS , or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .
- Understanding of environment management, monitoring, logging, and application deployment best practices.

high.title: SW Engineer (Java/Python Full stack, GenAI - 6 months to 2 years' experience only)
high.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Junior Software Engineers with AI-first, agentic coding expertise design, build, test, deploy, and maintain modern software applications while leveraging advanced Generative AI and agentic development tools to accelerate engineering outcomes. This role requires foundational software engineering skills combined with hands-on experience or strong familiarity using AI-assisted coding platforms and large language models such as Claude, OpenAI models, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other emerging AI development agents.

Junior Software Engineers are responsible for supporting software analysis, design, programming, debugging, optimization, and modification of applications across commercial, enterprise, and end-user environments. They write quality code, develop automated tests, support CI/CD pipelines, integrate systems, and assist with production application support under guidance from senior team members.

In addition to traditional engineering responsibilities, this role emphasizes the effective use of AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, automated code generation, AI-assisted debugging, test creation, documentation generation, and developer productivity automation. Engineers are expected to use AI tools responsibly, securely, and effectively while maintaining strong human oversight, code quality, compliance, and engineering standards.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI, large language models, AI agents, automation tools, and cloud-native engineering platforms to support everyday work.

Key Responsibilities



- Write, develop, modify, and review quality, testable, and maintainable code across front-end, back-end, API, integration, and data layers under guidance from senior engineers.
- Apply an AI-first engineering approach by using modern AI coding assistants and agentic development tools such as Claude, OpenAI models, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and similar platforms to improve development speed, code quality, documentation, and troubleshooting.
- Use agentic coding workflows to assist with code generation, refactoring, unit test creation, debugging, technical documentation, code reviews, and analysis of systems.
- Write effective prompts and provide clear engineering context to AI tools in order to generate reliable, secure, and maintainable software solutions.
- Validate, review, and refine AI-generated code to ensure correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and alignment with team coding standards.
- Support integration of applications and systems through REST APIs, GraphQL, messaging queues, event-driven architectures, databases, and third-party platforms.
- Assist in developing and maintaining data pipelines, batch jobs, and data processing solutions using appropriate frameworks and cloud services.
- Create and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, using automation and AI-assisted test generation where appropriate.
- Support and contribute to CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, security scanning, packaging, and deployment processes.
- Package and deploy applications across multiple environments using containers, orchestration platforms, and cloud-native deployment tools.
- Debug issues using logs, metrics, traces, observability platforms, and AI-assisted root cause analysis tools with support from senior team members.
- Monitor application performance and assist in identifying bottlenecks and implementing improvements.
- Participate in code reviews and support quality gates using static analysis, automated testing, security scanning, and AI-assisted review tools.
- Learn and apply secure coding practices, including input validation, authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, and secure API design.
- Ensure responsible and compliant use of AI tools, including protection of confidential data, intellectual property, regulated information, and customer-sensitive content.
- Maintain technical documentation, implementation guides, and operational support materials, using AI tools where appropriate to improve accuracy and efficiency.
- Collaborate with product managers, architects, business stakeholders, senior engineers, and end users to understand requirements and contribute to software solutions.
- Support estimation of development effort, contribute to project plans, and assist with delivery timelines and release schedules.
- Actively learn and stay current with emerging technologies, including Generative AI, agentic software development, cloud engineering, automation, DevSecOps, and modern application architecture.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Qualifications:



- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or any other related filed or with an Advanced degree
- 6 months - 2 years of experience in software development, software engineering, or a related technical field.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamps, certifications, self-taught with demonstrable projects).
- Foundational programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, Go, or similar languages.
- Exposure to or hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and large language models for software development, including tools such as:

- Claude
- OpenAI models (ChatGPT, GPT-4, etc.)
- GitHub Copilot
- Cursor
- CodeWhisperer or similar AI coding tools
- Basic understanding of prompt engineering for software development, including creating prompts for code generation, debugging, refactoring, test creation, and documentation.
- Familiarity with agentic coding patterns, including task decomposition, iterative prompting, AI-assisted planning, and autonomous development workflows with human review.
- Exposure to modern frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, Node.js, Spring Boot, .NET, Django, Flask, FastAPI, or similar technologies.
- Basic understanding of databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, or cloud-native data services.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
- Exposure to CI/CD and DevOps tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform.
- Understanding of software engineering fundamentals including version control (Git), automated testing, debugging, API design, and secure development practices.
- Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, security, and production readiness with guidance from senior engineers.
- Personal projects, internships, or academic work demonstrating use of AI tools for coding and development.
- Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio of GitHub repositories showcasing coding skills.
- Experience with agentic development frameworks or AI workflow automation tools.
- Familiarity with microservices architecture, event-driven systems, or distributed computing concepts.
- Experience with data engineering tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Spark, or cloud data services.
- Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms.
- Understanding of Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
- AI-First Engineering Expectations
- The successful candidate should be eager to work in an environment where AI tools are used as a core part of the software development lifecycle. This includes:
- Using AI agents to accelerate routine development tasks while learning to maintain engineering accountability.
- Reviewing and validating all AI-generated code before use in production.
- Applying secure and compliant AI usage practices.
- Learning to create reusable prompts, workflows, and development patterns.
- Improving personal and team productivity through automation and AI-enabled tooling.
- Adopting responsible AI coding practices.
- Continuously exploring and evaluating new AI development tools and 
- models for practical engineering use cases.
- What We're Looking For
- We are seeking motivated, curious, and adaptable individuals who:
- Are passionate about software engineering and eager to grow their technical skills.
- Embrace AI tools as productivity multipliers and are excited to learn and experiment with emerging technologies.
- Take ownership of their work, ask questions, and seek feedback to continuously improve.
- Communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and contribute positively to team culture.
- Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to quality.
- Are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.
Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

medium.title: SDE I Backend Engineer
medium.description:
Backend Engineer (SDE 1)


About Astra


Astra is a cybersecurity SaaS company that makes otherwise chaotic pentests a breeze with its one-of-a-kind Pentest Platform. Astra's continuous vulnerability scanner emulates hacker behavior to scan applications for 9,300+ security tests. CTOs & CISOs love Astra because it helps them fix vulnerabilities in record time and move from DevOps to DevSecOps with Astra's CI/CD integrations.
Astra is loved by 650+ companies across the globe. In 2023, Astra uncovered 2 million+ vulnerabilities for its customers, saving customers $69M+ in potential losses due to security vulnerabilities.
We've been awarded by the President of France, Mr. François Hollande, at the La French Tech program and the Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, at the Global Conference on Cyber Security. Loom, MamaEarth, Muthoot Finance, Canara Robeco, ScripBox, etc. are a few of Astra's customers.
Role Overview
At Astra Security, we are building the future of AI-driven cybersecurity, including Autonomous Pentesting — an experience that helps teams automatically discover, test, and secure Web & Mobile applications, Cloud, and APIs at scale.


As a Backend Engineer (SDE 1), you will work on building and improving the backend systems that power Astra's cybersecurity platform. You'll develop APIs, backend services, database components, and asynchronous workflows that support our core product.
You'll work closely with experienced backend engineers, frontend engineers, product managers, DevOps, and QA to build reliable and scalable features. You'll get hands-on experience taking features from development to production, debugging real-world issues, and learning how distributed backend systems are designed and operated at scale.
This is an opportunity to work on challenging engineering problems, contribute to 0-1 product initiatives, and grow your backend engineering skills in a fast-paced product environment.


Here's what's in it for you

- Build and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs for Astra's platform.
- Develop clean, maintainable, and reusable code following sound software engineering principles.
- Work with databases to design tables, write queries, and improve application performance.
- Build and work with asynchronous workflows using queues, events, and background processing.
- Debug production and development issues and identify the root cause of problems.
- Write unit and integration tests to ensure reliability and code quality.
- Work with AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity while reviewing and validating generated code before it reaches production.
- Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to continuously improve your engineering practices.
- Collaborate with frontend, product, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver features.
- Contribute to improving system reliability, developer productivity, and engineering processes.
- Learn and work with modern backend and distributed-system technologies.


What we're looking for

- 1- 3 years of experience building backend applications in a product-based or SaaS environment.
- Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Java, Python, PHP, or C++.
- Good understanding of OOP, data structures, algorithms, and core software engineering principles.
- Experience building or working with RESTful APIs.
- Good understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Ability to write efficient SQL queries and understand basic database design.
- Basic understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, events, or background jobs.
- Familiarity with concepts such as ORMs, dependency injection, data validation, caching, logging, and error handling.
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
- Good understanding of writing maintainable, testable code.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS is a plus.
- Experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools is a plus.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
- A strong learning mindset and willingness to take ownership of problems.


Why Astra?

- Opportunity to work on products that solve challenging real-world cybersecurity problems.
- Work on backend systems powering an AI-driven cybersecurity platform.
- Learn from experienced engineers and work closely with founders and product teams.
- Exposure to distributed systems, asynchronous processing, cloud infrastructure, and modern backend architecture.
- Ownership of features from development through production, with the right level of guidance and mentorship.
- Fast release cycles with the ability to ship code frequently.
- Collaborative engineering culture with a strong focus on learning and innovation.
- Join a team of builders and problem-solvers who thrive on first-principles thinking, move fast without breaking trust, and take pride in shipping products that matter.
- Opportunity to contribute to products from the ground up and grow rapidly as an engineer.
- Flexible hybrid work environment.
- Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
- Annual team off-sites and regular team events.
- A supportive, high-growth environment where your ideas and contributions can have a real impact.
Location
This is a hybrid role in Bengaluru and requires a regular in-office presence to collaborate closely with Engineering and Product teams. Being in-office helps foster deep collaboration, faster decision-making, and the shared energy of building together — values that define how we operate at Astra.
Location: Bengaluru, India

medium.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Role Summary:

Software Engineer - Full Stack

Visa’s Technology Organization is a community of problem solvers and innovators reshaping the future of commerce. We operate the world’s most sophisticated processing networks capable of handling more than 65k secure transactions a second across 80M merchants, 15k Financial Institutions, and billions of everyday people. While working with us you’ll get to work on complex distributed systems and solve massive scale problems centered on new payment flows, business and data solutions, cyber security, and B2C platforms.

The Opportunity

We are looking for dedicated, curious, and energetic Software Engineers who embrace solving complex challenges on a global scale. As a Visa Software Engineer, you will be an integral part of a multi-functional development team inventing, designing, building, and testing software products that reach a truly global customer base. While building components of innovative payment technology, you will get to see your efforts shaping the digital future of monetary transactions.

The Work Itself



- Design code and systems that touch 40% of the world population while influencing Visa’s internal standards for scalability, security, and reusability 
- Collaborate multi-functionally to create design artifacts and develop best-in-class software solutions for multiple Visa technical offerings 
- Actively contribute to product quality improvements, valuable service technology, and new business flows in diverse agile squads 
- Develop robust and scalable products intended for a myriad of customers including end-user merchants, b2b, and business to government solutions 
- Leverage innovative technologies to build the next generation of Payment Services, Transaction Platforms, Real-Time Payments, and Buy Now Pay Later Technology 
- Opportunities to make a difference on a global or local scale through mentorship and continued learning opportunities 

Essential Functions



- Supports relationship with product owners to gather and refine requirements for one product task, adding and taking into account existing tools and solutions within a product.
- Begins to develop and design architect solutions, considering integrations with other solutions.
- Provides relevant knowledge on the development of user documentation of solutions and follows standard processes in user documentation.
- Plays a minor role in the development and delivery of new features within a product. 

The Skills You Bring



- Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scale 
- Challenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing the boundaries, “hacking” beyond traditional solutions 
- Language Expertise: Expertise in one or more general development languages (e.g., Java, Python) 
- Builder: Experience building and deploying modern services and web applications with quality and scalability 
- Learner: Constant drive to learn new technologies such as Angular, React, Kubernetes, Docker, etc. 
- Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, Dev-ops, and Agile/Scrum teams 

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:



- Bachelor's degree in Math, Science, Engineering, or Computer Science, Information Systems or related field. OR 
- 6 Months - 2years of directly related experience. 

Preferred Qualifications



- You have strong knowledge of Java and Spring with relevant understanding of designing and building large scale enterprise Java applications.
- Strong knowledge and working experience in relational database technology: SQL, JDBC, DB2, MySQL
- Familiarity with no-SQL database technology
- Knowledge of and ability to develop front-end code (e.g. HTML, CSS, and JavaScript) in support of package and product development. This includes the extension of capabilities of packages and products.
- The ability to select the "best available" values of some objective function to improve the functional effectiveness of web browsers.
- Knowledge of user interface design, which is the interaction where users and computers
- interact. This includes an understanding of how to provide an optimal industrial design experience through User Interface (UI) Design.
- Knowledge of and ability to develop back-end (e.g. Python, Java, C++, PHP) code in support of package and product development. This includes the extension of capabilities of packages and products.
- The ability to develop and use Application Program Interfaces (APIs), a set of routines, protocols, and tools for building software applications that specify how software components should interact and are used when programming graphical user interface (GUI) components. An API may be for a web-based system, operating system, database system, computer hardware, or software library.
- Knowledge of and the ability to use database software (e.g., applications, web-based applications, information systems) to maintain, modify, and output data.
- Knowledge of systems integration process in which separately produced components or subsystems are combined and problems in their interactions are addressed.
- Knowledge of data structures, which consist of data organization, management, and storage formats that enable efficient access and modifications. This includes a collection of data values, the relationships among them, and the functions or operations that can be applied to the data.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
